title: Clay: every screen, element and gate, with router hops
notes: Revision 2026-10-09: curated screens from routes.json (one router hop each from any-page), every state and element edge from the read-only crawl in elements.json, and the earlier hand-written edges kept by id. Every control that saves, runs, sends, spends, creates, deletes or starts is a forbidden edge into gate-held: recorded, never routed through. Hand-written edges cost 1.0, never measured; crawled and curated costs are measured seconds in a background tab. Observed means seen by the crawler or the operator, not independently replayed; no mastery claim.
